queries: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS rm JOIN orders AS o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, risk_margin_records, risk_margin_records::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY acctscope

alternatives.interpretation: NULL is not an account scope, so exclude matched records whose user has no scope.
alternatives.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, risk_margin_records, CAST(risk_margin_records AS numeric) / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(risk_margin_records AS numeric) / AVG(CAST(risk_margin_records AS numeric)) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM scope_counts;
